nikolai.ref_en: Come in, come in, it is warm inside. Here in Oymyakon we drink hot tea, we keep the stove burning, and we never complain about the cold.
nikolai.ref_native: Заходите, заходите, внутри тепло. Здесь, в Оймяконе, мы пьём горячий чай, топим печку и никогда не жалуемся на холод.
nikolai.design: An old Russian village grandfather, about 70, speaking English with a heavy Russian accent: rolled R, hard consonants, Russian vowels. Deep, warm, dry humour, slow and calm.
test: You missed it. It was on Tuesday.

sardaana.ref_en: Good morning! I am Sardaana, I am nine years old, and I walk to school every day, even when it is very, very cold outside.
sardaana.design: A cheerful nine-year-old girl from Siberia speaking English with a light Russian accent. Bright, proud, energetic child voice, a bit cheeky.
test: Only when it's colder than minus fifty-two.

tourist.ref_en: Wait, what? You people really live out here? Come on, that sounds totally crazy to me.
tourist.design: An American man in his thirties, skeptical and surprised, expressive and slightly sarcastic, casual tone.
